dct_creator_sm: Population Research Laboratory (University of Alberta Population Research Laboratory, Department of Sociology, University of Alberta).
dct_description_sm: The Population Research Laboratory (PRL) administered the 2016 Alberta Survey B. This survey of households across the province of Alberta continues to enable academic researchers, government departments, and non-profit organizations to explore a wide range of topics in a structured research framework and environment. Sponsors’ research questions are asked together with demographic questions in a telephone interview of Alberta households.
